title: mors.load (command)
description: The restore command: renders the payload (a session's mors.export) and Claude's reply track without emitting ghost or accept events, bumps rev, and emits one mors.changed with by "restore". A load in the first 8 s after boot wins over the sessionStorage draft. The engine sends it when a saved session is resumed.

morse.description: The message as elements: . and - only, letters separated by a space, words by " / ". At most 4 000 elements; the limit here counts the separators too.

text.description: Ignored: the window decodes morse itself. Kept so a saved export can be sent back as it is.

wpm.description: Speed in words per minute to restore.

view.description: Which of Doto's extras to restore.

controller.description: key is the minimum; full is the full controller.

readback.description: The decoded characters are shown on the tape.

reply.description: Claude's track to restore: what mors.play had played, in the same notation as morse.

ghost.description: A ghost to show after the message. The load emits no ghost event for it.

keyed.description: How many of the ghost's letters are already done.
